SceneIO builds only miniz.c and exposes this directory to the extension so
TinyEXR and SceneIO's SPZ/ZIP users consume the same miniz.h. The integration
builds one position-independent static library with hidden C symbol
visibility. Upstream CMake files, shared libraries, install rules, tools,
examples, and tests are not configured or built.

Local patches: none. Every repository-contained upstream file is byte-exact
with the selected release archive.
